openings.claim: Consensus next check: establish reversible attachment feasibility, then test one lateral-stop candidate against coupled acceptance outcomes. This is a probe, not deployment.
openings.delta: Change the sideways-load carrier from seal friction to padded strip contacts: two removable rim saddles using four strips, six bolt/nut sets and four pads, with cord retaining removed assemblies outside the opening.
openings.prediction: Nearest rival: stronger retention supplies sufficient friction. Lateral registration predicts at most 1 mm displacement under 20 N without added corner lift or slower reopening; the rival needs additional restraint. Geometry may defeat either account. Balanced pressure remains an untested alternative, not a contradictory prediction about the same joint.
openings.probe: First inspect rim access, strip span, pad placement and external tether clearance without loading the seal. If removable attachment and unobstructed opening are unsupported, park fabrication. Otherwise fabricate within ninety minutes; perform ten numbered opening/closure/pull cycles within twenty minutes, disturbing final closure with the right-contact card. Record marked displacement, corner heights, reopening time, visible tears and maintenance with supplied ruler, scale and stopwatch. Defeat acceptance for displacement above 1 mm, failed 20 N retention, reopening above thirty seconds, tears, permanent deformation, unrecoverable parts or obstructed inspection; waive only disturbed seal-contact continuity. Stop for damage; stopping alone supplies no feasibility evidence.
assumptions: Rim geometry, pad behavior, strip stiffness and tether attachment are unspecified.
One technician can operate and record within the allowance; borderline ruler readings remain uncertain.
Ten cycles validate only one configuration; no causal winner follows from this allocation.

assessment: Attachment feasibility is immediately decision-changing. Passing coupled outcomes supports further evaluation only. Pressure redistribution versus geometry remains unresolved. Supplied commitments concern different interventions or conditional failure possibilities, so no pair establishes incompatible predictions; agreement is not evidence.

lineage.reason: Retain coupled outcomes and technician burden in the candidate probe.
Make attachment feasibility the first gate and consolidate acceptance observations.
Distinct pressure carrier remains plausible; twelve trials cannot establish ten-cycle outcomes for both candidates.
